name: Apache Spark
certifications: Databricks Certified Associate Developer for Apache Spark
tools: Databricks Free Edition or a local cluster

beginner.summary: For data engineers, analysts and developers new to Spark. Covers Spark architecture, set-up, RDDs, DataFrames, reading and writing data, selecting and filtering, column functions, aggregations, joins, window functions, Spark SQL, missing and messy data, nested data, user-defined functions, partitions, caching, the Spark UI, Parquet and Delta, a first streaming job and submitting applications.
prerequisites: Writes Python and SQL with joins and GROUP BY
Knows basic data formats such as CSV and JSON
outcomes: Explain how Spark runs work across a cluster
Load, clean, join and aggregate large data with DataFrames and Spark SQL
Store data efficiently in Parquet and Delta
Read the Spark UI and run Spark applications

days.topic: Apache Spark Overview, Architecture and Local Setup
subtopics: Why Spark: data too large for one machine
Spark compared with pandas, Hadoop MapReduce and SQL warehouses
Driver, executors and the cluster manager
Local mode, standalone, YARN and Kubernetes
Installing PySpark locally and with Docker
Notebooks with Jupyter and Databricks Free Edition
The course datasets: taxi trips and retail orders
days.lab_task: Install PySpark locally and in Docker, start a SparkSession, read the taxi trip data, count rows and open the Spark UI to find the job, stages and tasks it ran.
days.deliverable: Set-up notes, notebook and Spark UI screenshots

subtopics: Actions: collect, count, take and reduce
days.lab_task: Count words in a large text corpus with RDDs, compare reduceByKey and groupByKey in the Spark UI and show that nothing runs until an action is called.
checks: No job in the Spark UI
Recovery from a lost partition described

days.lab_task: Load orders with an inferred and an explicit schema, compare load time and types, fix a column inferred as a string and convert a small summary to pandas.
days.deliverable: Notebook with both schemas and timings
checks: Correct numeric type in the schema

days.lab_task: Read CSV, JSON and a PostgreSQL table, handle corrupt records, write the result as partitioned Parquet and read it back filtered by partition.
checks: Read a file with corrupt lines
Bad lines captured in a corrupt record column

days.lab_task: Clean the taxi data: select needed columns, rename them, filter impossible trips, add trip duration and a fare band with when and otherwise, and write the steps as one readable chain.
checks: Negative fares and zero distances removed
Bands assigned correctly for sample rows

days.topic: Built-In Functions for Strings, Dates and Numbers
days.lab_task: Parse messy address strings with regular expressions, convert timestamps between time zones, extract hour and weekday features and round fares correctly.
checks: City and postcode extracted for sample rows
Local times correct for three trips

days.lab_task: Report trips and revenue by borough and hour, pivot by weekday, compute median fares and compare exact and approximate distinct driver counts with their run times.
checks: Shuffle stage found for the groupBy

days.lab_task: Join trips with zones and weather, broadcast the small zone table, find trips with no matching zone using an anti join and fix a join that duplicates rows.
checks: Row count matches the trips table

days.lab_task: Rank drivers by daily revenue within each borough, compute running revenue, time between a driver's trips with lag and keep only the latest record per order.

subtopics: Choosing SQL or the DataFrame API
days.lab_task: Rewrite three DataFrame reports in Spark SQL, create managed and external tables, mix SQL and Python in one pipeline and compare the physical plans.
days.deliverable: SQL and Python versions and plan comparison

days.topic: Handling Missing, Duplicate and Messy Data
days.lab_task: Profile nulls and duplicates in the orders data, apply cleaning rules, send bad rows to a quarantine table with reasons and produce a quality summary.
days.deliverable: Cleaning notebook, quarantine table and summary

subtopics: Higher-order functions: transform, filter and aggregate
days.lab_task: Read nested order JSON with item arrays, explode items, total each order with higher-order functions without exploding, and flatten the result for reporting.
checks: Same totals as the exploded version

days.lab_task: Write a Python UDF, a pandas UDF and a built-in version of the same calculation, compare run times, and use applyInPandas to fit a small model per store.
checks: Built-in fastest and pandas UDF faster than Python UDF

days.lab_task: Measure partition sizes, change shuffle partitions for a large aggregation, fix a job that writes thousands of tiny files and record run times.
days.deliverable: Notebook, Spark UI notes and timings
checks: Output written as fewer, larger files

subtopics: Caching compared with writing to storage
days.lab_task: Reuse a cleaned DataFrame in three reports with and without caching, check the Storage tab, unpersist it and break a long lineage with a checkpoint.
checks: Faster with caching for reused data

days.topic: Reading the Spark UI and Query Plans
subtopics: Logical and physical plans with explain
days.lab_task: Run four slow jobs, find the slow stage in each from the Spark UI and plans, and explain whether the cause is a shuffle, skew, spill or too few tasks.
checks: One task much longer than others

days.topic: Parquet, Delta Lake and Table Formats
subtopics: Parquet internals: row groups and statistics
days.lab_task: Compare CSV and Parquet for size and query speed, convert orders to Delta, upsert changes with MERGE, read an older version and compact small files.
days.deliverable: Notebook, size and speed comparison and Delta history

days.topic: A First Look at Structured Streaming
days.lab_task: Stream order files from a folder, count orders per minute, write to a Delta table with a checkpoint, stop and restart the stream and confirm no duplicates.
checks: Input rate and batch duration shown

days.lab_task: Turn the cleaning notebook into a PySpark application with arguments, logging and tests, package its dependencies and run it with spark-submit locally and on a small cluster.
days.deliverable: Application repository, tests and run logs

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: City Taxi Analytics Pipeline
days.lab_task: Build a Spark application that ingests a year of taxi trips, cleans and joins them with zones and weather, writes Delta reporting tables partitioned by month and passes a review of its Spark UI.
days.deliverable: Application, tests, reporting tables and demo recording
checks: Job completes and tables are written
Report totals match the cleaned data
No skewed or spilling stages left
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one pipeline

intermediate.summary: For engineers who write Spark jobs. Covers execution internals, adaptive query execution, join strategies and skew, memory and spill, configuration, data layout, Delta Lake operations, Iceberg, Structured Streaming with Kafka, watermarks, stateful streaming, slowly changing dimensions, testing, Spark on Kubernetes, EMR, Dataproc and Databricks, MLlib, GraphFrames, Spark Connect and the developer certification.
prerequisites: Writes PySpark DataFrame and Spark SQL jobs
outcomes: Tune Spark jobs using plans, AQE, join strategies and memory settings
Design table layouts and run Delta and Iceberg operations
Build reliable stateful streaming pipelines with Kafka
Test, deploy and run Spark on Kubernetes and cloud services

days.topic: Spark Execution Internals: Catalyst, Tungsten and Stages
days.lab_task: Trace one query from logical plan to physical plan, find which optimisation rules changed it, identify code generation stages and predict the number of stages before running it.
Run three queries with AQE off and on, show partitions being coalesced, a sort-merge join becoming a broadcast join and a skewed join being split.
days.deliverable: Plans and timings for each query

days.lab_task: Fix a join with one hot customer by salting, compare join hints on a medium table and bucket two tables that are joined every day.

days.topic: Memory Management, Spill and Executor Sizing
subtopics: Out-of-memory errors on driver and executors
days.lab_task: Reproduce driver and executor out-of-memory errors, fix them, size executors for a 1 TB job and compare run times with three executor shapes.
days.deliverable: Error diagnosis, sizing calculation and timings
checks: Spill or partitioning change fixes it

days.lab_task: Tune a slow daily job step by step, changing one setting at a time, recording the effect of each in the History Server and keeping only changes that help.
days.deliverable: Tuning log with before and after timings
checks: One setting per run with its effect

days.topic: Data Layout: Partitioning, Bucketing, Z-Ordering and Clustering
days.lab_task: Lay out a 1-billion-row events table four ways (no layout, date partitions, Z-order and liquid clustering) and compare files read and time for three common queries.
checks: Fewest files with the best layout for each query

days.lab_task: Speed up a slow MERGE, read the change data feed downstream, add constraints, run two writers to cause a conflict and restore a table after a bad write.
checks: Data back to the earlier version

days.lab_task: Create an Iceberg table with hidden partitioning, evolve its partition spec without rewriting data, time travel, expire snapshots and query it from Trino.
days.deliverable: Notebook, snapshot history and Trino query
checks: New data uses the new spec without rewrite

days.topic: Structured Streaming with Kafka Sources and Sinks
days.lab_task: Read Avro orders from Kafka with Schema Registry, enrich them, upsert into Delta with foreachBatch and write alerts back to another topic.
checks: Batch duration stays within the trigger

days.topic: Event Time, Watermarks and Windowed Aggregations
days.lab_task: Count orders per five-minute window by event time, send late events beyond the watermark, use session windows for user activity and test with fixed input.
Join orders and payments streams within 30 minutes, deduplicate events, track per-user state with timeouts and monitor state size.

days.topic: Slowly Changing Dimensions and Incremental Loads
days.lab_task: Load customers incrementally with a high-water mark into a type 2 dimension with MERGE, handle a late update and re-run a load to prove it is idempotent.
days.deliverable: Load job, dimension table and tests
checks: Old and new versions with dates
No changes on the second run

days.lab_task: Add unit tests for transformations, a streaming test with memory input, an integration test against Kafka in a container and run them all in CI.
checks: All tests pass on the runner

days.lab_task: Build a Spark image, run the capstone job on Kubernetes with the Spark Operator, turn on dynamic allocation and view the run in the History Server.
days.deliverable: Image, SparkApplication manifest and run evidence
checks: Driver and executors run and finish

days.topic: Spark on Cloud Services: EMR, Dataproc and Databricks
days.lab_task: Run the same job on EMR Serverless and on one other platform, read cloud storage with roles instead of keys and compare run time and cost.
days.deliverable: Job definitions, run logs and comparison
checks: Job succeeds reading S3 with a role

days.lab_task: Build an MLlib pipeline to predict trip tips, tune it with cross-validation, save and reload it and score a billion rows in batch.

subtopics: When to use a graph database instead
days.lab_task: Build a graph of accounts and shared devices, find connected components to spot fraud rings, rank accounts with PageRank and find a motif of circular payments.
Run jobs through Spark Connect from a laptop, write a Python data source for an internal API and upgrade a Spark 3 job, fixing ANSI mode errors.
days.deliverable: Spark Connect set-up, data source and upgrade notes
checks: Job runs on the remote server
Read from the Python data source
API data returned as a DataFrame

days.topic: Developer for Apache Spark Certification Preparation
days.lab_task: Take a timed practice exam, review wrong answers by running the code, practise weak areas and take a second exam.
days.deliverable: Two practice scores and a weak-areas list

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Streaming and Batch Order Analytics
days.lab_task: Build order analytics with a Kafka stream joined to payments, windowed metrics with watermarks, a type 2 customer dimension, tuned layouts, tests in CI and deployment on Kubernetes, then demo a crash and recovery.
days.deliverable: Repository, tests, deployment manifests and demo recording
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one system
Build reliable batch and streaming jobs

advanced.summary: For senior data engineers and Spark platform owners. Covers Spark internals, the shuffle service, cost-based optimisation, petabyte-scale tuning, Photon and native engines, advanced streaming, extending Spark, lakehouse architecture, multi-tenant platforms, observability, cost, security, migrations, Spark for AI workloads, Ray and Spark together, GPU acceleration, reliability, Spark contributions and a platform capstone.
prerequisites: Tunes jobs with plans, AQE and memory settings
outcomes: Diagnose and tune Spark at very large scale
Extend Spark and choose engines and accelerators
Design multi-tenant, secure and observable Spark platforms
Migrate and run Spark for analytics and AI workloads

days.topic: Spark Internals: Scheduler, Shuffle and Storage
days.lab_task: Trace a shuffle-heavy job through event logs, kill an executor mid-shuffle and explain recovery, and compare default and push-based shuffle.
checks: Lost stages re-run and the job completes
Stage and task flow described correctly

days.lab_task: Collect statistics for a star schema, show join reordering with the cost-based optimiser, compare plans with stale statistics and record when hints were still needed.
Tune a 100 TB join between two tables, fix driver pressure from file listing, split the job into stages that can be retried and report time and cost.

days.topic: Native Engines: Photon, Gluten and Velox
days.lab_task: Run a TPC-DS subset on standard Spark and a native engine, find operators that fall back to the JVM and estimate cost per query.
checks: Cost per query for each engine

days.topic: Advanced Streaming: Latency, Real-Time Mode and Operations
subtopics: Real-time mode in recent Spark releases
days.lab_task: Bring a stream under one-second latency, upgrade it with a changed state schema without losing state and run three streams on one cluster with fair scheduling.
days.deliverable: Configuration, latency measurements and upgrade notes
checks: Under one second at the target load

days.topic: Extending Spark: Data Sources, Catalyst Rules and Plugins
subtopics: Spark plugins for drivers and executors
days.lab_task: Write a data source with filter push-down, a listener that reports job metrics to Prometheus and a simple optimiser rule, and test each.

subtopics: Catalogs: Unity Catalog, Polaris and Glue
Serving data to BI and ML
days.lab_task: Design a lakehouse for a retailer with Spark processing, a chosen table format and catalog, BI and ML serving and multi-engine access, and defend it in a review.
days.deliverable: Architecture, decision records and review notes

subtopics: Cluster per job compared with shared clusters
days.lab_task: Set up queues and quotas for three teams on Kubernetes, provide job templates, stop one team using another's data and report cost by team.
days.deliverable: Platform configuration, templates and cost report

subtopics: Event logs and the History Server at scale
days.lab_task: Export Spark metrics to Prometheus, build job dashboards, alert when a daily job runs 30 percent slower than usual and analyse a run with Dataflint.
checks: Executors, stages and job times shown

days.lab_task: Measure cost per job for ten daily jobs, cut the top three with right-sizing, spot workers and layout changes, and report monthly savings.

subtopics: Encryption in transit and at rest
days.lab_task: Turn on encryption, apply row and column policies through the catalog, remove secrets from job code and audit who read a sensitive table.
days.deliverable: Security configuration, policies and audit report
checks: Read a masked column as an analyst
Reads of the sensitive table listed by user

days.topic: Migrating to Spark and Between Spark Platforms
subtopics: Migrating from Hadoop MapReduce, Hive and Pig
Moving between EMR, Databricks and Kubernetes
days.lab_task: Migrate three Hive jobs to Spark, move one Spark job from EMR to Kubernetes, validate outputs row by row and plan the cutover.
days.deliverable: Migrated jobs, validation report and cutover plan

days.topic: Spark for AI and LLM Data Pipelines
days.lab_task: Clean and deduplicate 10 million documents with MinHash, generate embeddings in batches, run batch LLM classification through an endpoint with rate limits and write vector-ready tables.
days.deliverable: Pipeline, deduplication stats and output tables

subtopics: Distributed training with Ray after Spark preparation
days.lab_task: Prepare features with Spark, pass them to Ray for distributed training and tuning, and compare with doing everything in Spark MLlib.
checks: Ray reads Spark output without copies through the driver

days.topic: GPU Acceleration with RAPIDS for Spark
days.lab_task: Run the qualification tool on five jobs, run the best candidate on GPUs, profile it and compare time and cost with CPUs.
days.deliverable: Qualification report, profile and cost comparison
checks: GPU and CPU cost per run

days.lab_task: Define freshness SLOs for three pipelines, inject storage, executor and source failures, confirm recovery within the SLO and write runbooks.
Diagnose five injected failures (a fetch failure storm, a new skewed key, an upstream schema change, a full worker disk and a driver crash), fix each and write a post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis notes, fixes and a post-incident review

days.topic: Contributing to Apache Spark and the Ecosystem
days.lab_task: Build Spark from source, run a module's tests, reproduce a known issue with a minimal example and write an issue report or small documentation fix.
days.deliverable: Build log, reproduction and issue or pull request draft

days.topic: Spark Platform Strategy and Team Practices
days.lab_task: Write Spark standards for a data team, a review checklist and a 12-month platform roadmap, and present it to a role-play leadership panel.

Design and build a Spark platform for a case company: lakehouse layout, multi-tenant scheduling, security policies, observability, cost reporting and a tuned petabyte-scale job, then run a game day with failures and present to an architecture board.
days.deliverable: Architecture records, platform code, tuning results, game day report and board presentation
checks: Cost per team and per job
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
Run Spark at very large scale
